story.p1: I-{{full}} yaqala ngomzuzu wokuziqhenya. U-{{founder}} wabona umngane wakhe oseduze eqala inkampani yakhe, egxile ezinsizakalweni zokuthengisa, futhi wazibonela ukuthi kudinga isibindi esingakanani ukuqala.
story.p2: Lowo mzuzu wahlala kuye. Sekuyisikhathi eside enothando lokusiza ama-SMME afinyelele imigomo yawo, athuthuke futhi akhule, futhi wayefuna ukwakha into ezoma nawo ngenkathi enza lokho.
story.p3: Igama lingumlayezo ayefuna ukuwuthumela kumngane wakhe, nakuwo wonke amabhizinisi nezinhlangano eziyisebenzisayo: niyakwazi. Qhubekani nilwela phambili, ningaze niyeke.
story.title: Indaba yethu

about.tagline: I-CRM ehlanganisa ibhizinisi lakho, amakhasimende akho nethimba lakho.

channels.emailPresetIntro: Khetha umhlinzeki wakho ukuze kugcwaliswe imininingwane yeseva ngezansi. Uzodinga kuphela ikheli le-imeyili nephasiwedi.

hints.only_known_customers: Ama-imeyili avela emakhelini angewona amakhasimende ahlala ebhokisini lakho, ukuze izindaba nogaxekile kungangeni ku-YGT.

channels.mailboxIntro: Xhuma ibhokisi elifanayo othumela kulo. I-YGT ilihlola njalo ngomzuzu futhi ifake izimpendulo zamakhasimende ezingxoxweni zawo. Ayisusi noma iphawule ama-imeyili akho njengafundiwe.
channels.smsIntro: Thumela futhi wamukele ama-SMS nge-akhawunti yakho kumhlinzeki we-SMS. Ukhokhela umhlinzeki ngqo ngemilayezo.

smsSteps.account: Vula i-akhawunti ku-BulkSMS, Clickatell noma Twilio bese uthenga ikhredithi.
smsSteps.keys: Dala okhiye be-API kudeshibhodi yomhlinzeki bese ubanamathisela ngezansi.
smsSteps.sender: Engeza i-ID yomthumeli noma inombolo evunyelwe ngumhlinzeki wakho (amanethiwekhi amaningi aseNingizimu Afrika adinga i-ID yomthumeli ebhalisiwe).
smsSteps.webhook: Londoloza, hlola ngenombolo yakho, bese usetha i-webhook URL eboniswe ngezansi njengekheli le-SMS engenayo lomhlinzeki.

webhookHelp.sms: Kudeshibhodi yomhlinzeki wakho we-SMS, setha leli njengekheli lemilayezo engenayo (inbound / reply webhook) ukuze izimpendulo zifike ku-YGT.
webhookHelp.whatsapp: Namathisela lokhu ku-Meta: WhatsApp > Configuration > Webhook, bese ubhalisela "messages". Yile ndlela izimpendulo zamakhasimende ezifika ngayo ku-YGT.

channels.whatsappIntro: Xhuma inombolo yakho ye-WhatsApp Business nge-Cloud API esemthethweni ye-Meta. Imilayezo iphuma enombolweni yakho futhi izimpendulo zingena kuMilayezo.

whatsappSteps.app: Iya ku-developers.facebook.com, dala i-app yohlobo lwe-Business bese wengeza umkhiqizo we-WhatsApp.
whatsappSteps.ids: Ngaphansi kwe-WhatsApp > API Setup, engeza inombolo yocingo yebhizinisi lakho bese ukopisha i-Phone number ID ne-WhatsApp Business Account ID.
whatsappSteps.save: Namathisela ngezansi, khetha "Sebenzisa i-WhatsApp", londoloza, bese uhlola ngenombolo yakho yeselula.
whatsappSteps.token: Ku-Business Settings > System users, dala i-access token ehlala njalo enemvume ye-whatsapp_business_messaging.
whatsappSteps.webhook: Kopisha i-webhook URL ne-verify token okuboniswa emva kokulondoloza kuzilungiselelo ze-webhook ze-Meta.
whatsappSteps.window: Umthetho we-WhatsApp: ungaphendula ngokukhululeka amahora angu-24 emva kokuba ikhasimende likuthumelele umlayezo; ukuqala ingxoxo emva kwalokho kudinga i-template evunyelwe yi-Meta.

errors.RATE_LIMITED: Imizamo eminingi kakhulu. Sicela ulinde kancane bese uzama futhi.

errors.STATEMENT_PERIOD_INVALID: Usuku lokuqala kufanele lube ngaphambi kosuku lokugcina.
errors.TICKET_CLOSED: Leli thikithi livaliwe. Vula elisha uma usadinga usizo.

Iyalandelela futhi ikukhumbuzele ngezinkokhelo, ikongela amahora njalo ngesonto nemali obungayilahlekelwa, ukuze ugxile ekuqhubeni ibhizinisi lakho.

how.title: Usebenza ntambama eyodwa
how.intro: Abekho abeluleki futhi akukho ukusetha okude. Uma ukwazi ukusebenzisa i-WhatsApp, ungasebenzisa i-YGT.

setup.title: Setha ibhizinisi lakho
setup.body: Engeza ilogo yakho, inombolo ye-VAT nemininingwane yasebhange, bese ungenisa amakhasimende akho usuka ku-Excel.

sell.title: Linganisa ukhiphe ama-invoyisi
sell.body: Thumela izilinganiso ezisezingeni eliphezulu, uguqule lezo ezamukelwe zibe ama-invoyisi entela, bese urekhoda izinkokhelo njengoba zifika.

grow.title: Landelela ukhule
grow.body: Landelela sonke isivumelwano, thumela imiyalezo kumakhasimende nge-WhatsApp ne-imeyili, bese ubona okusebenzayo.

features.title: Konke okudingwa ithimba lakho lokuthengisa
features.intro: Isistimu eyodwa esikhundleni sezinhlanu, eyakhelwe ama-SMME, izinsizakalo zobungcweti nezinhlangano.

card.a: Cha. Lonke uhlelo luqala ngokuzama mahhala izinsuku ezingu-14. Wengeza ikhadi kuphela uma ukhetha uhlelo.

vat.a: Yebo. Inombolo yakho ye-VAT neyeklayenti lakho ziyavela ezilinganisweni nakuma-invoyisi entela, nesamba ngaphandle kwe-VAT, i-VAT nesamba esifaka i-VAT.

import.a: Yebo. Ngenisa amakhasimende, imikhiqizo nezivumelwano usuka kuspredishithi noma kwenye i-CRM emizuzwini embalwa.

phone.a: Yebo. I-YGT isebenza kusiphequluli kunoma iyiphi ifoni, ithebhulethi noma ikhompyutha, ukuze ukwazi ukulinganisa usendaweni yeklayenti.

data.a: Idatha yenkampani ngayinye igcinwa iyimfihlo futhi ihlukile kweyezinye izinkampani, ngokuhambisana ne-POPIA, futhi ungayikhipha noma nini.

help.a: Faka ithikithi lokwesekwa ku-app, noma ubhukhe iseshini yevidiyo yamahhala nethimba lethu.

final.title: Uyakwazi. Thina sizophatha ukuphatha.
final.body: Qala namuhla ukuzama kwakho mahhala kwezinsuku ezingu-14. Alidingeki ikhadi.

scene.whatsapp: Sawubona! Ngingathola isingcaphuno samakhekhe amancane angu-40 ngoMgqibelo?

people.title: Yakhelwe ama-SMME acaphunayo, akhipha ama-invoyisi futhi akhulayo
people.intro: Noma ngabe uthengisa insizakalo noma umkhiqizo, uma uthumela izingcaphuno nama-invoyisi, i-{{name}} iphatha ihhovisi lakho elingemuva kusukela ngosuku lokuqala, ukuze ubukeke usungumisekile ngisho usaqala.

catering.label: Ukudla kwemicimbi
catering.a: Isingcaphuno samukelwe: umshado wezivakashi eziyi-120, R 38 400

construction.label: Ukwakha
construction.a: Isingcaphuno sithunyelwe: ukulungiswa kwendlu yokugezela, R 46 500

cleaning.label: Izinsizakalo zokuhlanza
cleaning.a: Inkontileka yokuhlanza yanyanga zonke yamukelwe: R 6 800

accounting.label: Ukubalwa kwezimali nokugcinwa kwamabhuku
accounting.a: Izimali zanyanga zonke zifakwe ku-invoyisi zamakhasimende angu-14

events.label: Imicimbi nokuhlobisa
events.a: Isingcaphuno samukelwe: ukuhlobisa umcimbi wokuphela konyaka, R 27 000

savings.title: Isikhathi siyabuya. Imali iyabuya.
savings.year: Lokho kucishe kube yizinsuku zokusebenza ezingu-{{days}} ezibuyayo njalo ngonyaka.
savings.note: Lesi yisilinganiso, akusona isithembiso. Kucabanga ukuthi wonga cishe imizuzu engu-{{minutes}} esingcaphunweni ngasinye noma ku-invoyisi ongasadingi ukuyithayipha, ukuyithumela nokuyilandelela wena.

aging.title: Ubani okukweletayo
aging.subtitle: Kusukela ngo-{{date}}: imali esakweletwa kuma-invoyisi athunyelwe, ngokuthi isephuze kangakanani.
aging.emptyHint: Ama-invoyisi athunyelwe angakhokhwanga ngokuphelele avela lapha, izikweletu ezindala kuqala.

recurring.title: Ama-invoyisi aphindaphindwayo
recurring.subtitle: Izivumelwano zenyanga nezinkontileka: umjikelezo ngamunye wenza i-invoyisi esalungiswa ukuze uyihlole futhi uyithumele.
recurring.newHint: Umjikelezo ngamunye wenza i-invoyisi esalungiswa. Akukho okuthunyelwayo uze uyithumele.
recurring.emptyHint: Setha eyodwa yezivumelwano zenyanga, izinkontileka zanyanga zonke noma ukubhalisa. Umjikelezo ngamunye wenza okusalungiswa; akukho okuphumayo uze ukuthumele.
recurring.deleteConfirm: Misa le invoyisi ephindaphindwayo? Ama-invoyisi esiyenzile ayahlala.
recurring.noneMade: Awekho ama-invoyisi enziwe okwamanje. Okusalungiswa kokuqala kuvela ngosuku lokuqala.
recurring.detailHint: Umjikelezo ngamunye wenza i-invoyisi esalungiswa ukuze uyihlole futhi uyithumele.
recurring.editHint: Izinguquko zisebenza kuma-invoyisi asazayo. Ama-invoyisi asenziwe ahlala enjalo.

discovery.title: Ukuthola
discovery.subtitle: Amakhasimende angaba khona atholakala isonto ngalinye. Akukho okungena ohlelweni lwakho uze ukwengeze.
discovery.emptyHint: Ukuthola kubheka njalo ngoMsombuluko ekuseni bese kuthumela i-imeyili kubaphathi bakho uma kuthola othile.
discovery.emptySetup: Setha indawo yakho nohlobo lwamakhasimende owafunayo, ukuze Ukuthola kuthole namabhizinisi aseduze kwakho.
discovery.privacy: Lezi yiziphakamiso kuphela: i-YGT ayibathinti neze. Amabhizinisi aseduze avela kudatha yamamephu yomphakathi,

settings.title: Lapho kufanele kubhekwe khona
settings.hint: Ukuthola kubheka lezi zinhlobo zamabhizinisi eduze kwakho, namakhasimende emarekhodini akho okufanele ashayelwe.
settings.weekly: Bheka isonto ngalinye bese uthumela i-imeyili kubaphathi
settings.summary: Kubhekwa ngaphakathi kwe-{{km}} km ukusuka e-{{area}}.
settings.noArea: Ayikasethwa indawo: kuhlolwa amarekhodi akho kuphela.

nearby.looking: Kufunwa amabhizinisi aseduze kwe-{{area}}… Lokhu kungathatha umzuzu noma emibili; azovela lapha.
nearby.failed: Insiza yemephu ibimatasa, ngakho amabhizinisi aseduze awahlolwanga. Ukuthola kuzozama futhi ngoMsombuluko.

edit.title: Hlela u-{{number}}
edit.subtitle: Shintsha imigqa, izinsuku namanothi. Ikhasimende lihlala lifana.
edit.notDraft: Kungashintshwa kuphela okusalungiswa lapha. Vula idokhumenti ukuze ubone okungenzeka.
edit.reviseBody: Lesi silinganiso sesithunyelwe. Ukusihlela kusibuyisela kokusalungiswa: yenza izinguquko, bese usithumela futhi ukuze ikhasimende lithole inguqulo entsha.
edit.correctBody: I-invoyisi esithunyelwe ayikwazi ukushintshwa: ikhasimende lakho seliyinayo. U-{{number}} uzokhanselwa bese kuvulwa ikhophi esalungiswa enemigqa efanayo ukuze uyilungise futhi uyithumele.
edit.corrected: U-{{old}} ukhanseliwe. Lungisa u-{{number}}, bese umthumela.
